purpose: Teach: アトム/ウィルソン/ロジャー/琢磨/綾子/ユーゴ/金具/悪しき

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが鉄腕アトムのファンだった
lines.en: Gran, back when we were young, I was quite the Astro Boy fan, you know.
lines.style: Slow nostalgic opening, a chuckle buried under the words. Low warm volume, fond unhurried finish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ウィルソン大統領の歴史を学ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you studied the history of President Wilson when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle teasing affection, papery warmth. Slow pace, a melodic rise blooming into the closing question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがロジャー・ムーアの007を観られた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I went and saw Roger Moore's 007 films.
lines.style: Wistful private smile in the voice. Deliberate pace, savoring the film title, soft settling close.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、F1の中嶋琢磨選手を応援されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you cheered for Takuma Nakajima in Formula One when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Fond amusement wrapped in tenderness. Unhurried pace, playful lift on the racing memory, soft question tag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが幸田綾子の写真集を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, in my younger days, I kept a photo book of Ayako Kouda on my shelf.
lines.style: Slightly sheepish warmth, confessing an old fondness. Slow pace, a small self-deprecating dip at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、旧ユーゴスラビアにも旅行されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You even traveled to the old Yugoslavia when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright delighted remembering. Gentle quickened pace, wonder lifting the far country, warm closing question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家具の金具をご自身で取り換えられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I replaced the metal fittings on our furniture with my own hands.
lines.style: Quiet pride surfacing. Measured pace, the old handiwork remembered in the voice, satisfied gentle finish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、悪しき習慣を断ち切られた経験ありましたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you broke off a bad habit for good, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Deep admiring tenderness closing the memory. Slowest pace, love steadying the final word, soft landing.
